header:
Awesome Content Creation

> Open-source tools for writers, designers, podcasters and creators: writing, images, audio, design, blogging and publishing. Every entry shows its license. **Rules of this list:** every repo exists, is public, is not archived, states a license and has had a commit in the last year. One plain sentence each. Star counts and claims are the authors' own, we did not test every tool. Checked 2026-10-18. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
footer:
## How to choose

- **Credit your sources.** Open-source tools can still output things you need to credit or clear.
- **Disclose AI use** where your platform or audience expects it.
- **Edit AI drafts.** Facts and tone need your check.
- **Check the license** before you use a tool or its output for client work.

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). One entry per pull request, plain words, real sources only.
